properties.name: A release that is out and records shipping nothing is now reported, and the cut procedure it belongs to is in the graph instead of in one agent's notes. `release_without_manifest` fires on a Release with an epoch, a deployment and zero INCLUDES — the v0.38.0 shape, which every check that ran passed over. It never consults `Release.status`, because rel:v0380 was published while its status read `planned`, and the sibling `release_without_epoch` was hardened the same way after this rule's own tests caught it trusting that field. `flow:release-cut` records the eight steps and their two backward resync edges; it is this design's FIRST Flow node, dogfooding a capability shipped long ago and never used on itself.
